The selected form has a written vav for the first holam and no written vav for the second: the second holam is placed directly on the second lamed. Its full-vav/defective-vav label therefore fits.

The Leningrad quotation retains the initial written holam-vav and also writes vav for the second holam. Both sites are full. The repeated full-vav/defective-vav description does not fit that quotation.
The printed-edition quotation lacks the first holam-vav (holam is on he) and writes the second; its defective-vav/full-vav label fits and confirms the positional order used by the note.
